title: 2023 Panini Prestige Xtra Points Hyper #58 Cris Collinsworth Cincinnati Bengals
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prestige Xtra Points Hyper #58 trading card features Cris Collinsworth of the Cincinnati Bengals in the National Football League (NFL). The card is a sports trading card with a parallel/variety feature, manufactured by Panini. It is not autographed and belongs to the 2023 season.

The card name is Cris Collinsworth and it is a part of the 2023 Panini Prestige set. The card number is 58 and it is categorized under Trading Card Singles, Sports Trading Cards, and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. This card is a must-have for any football enthusiast and a great addition to any trading card collection.
